NEW SECTION . 509A.13F Health insurance coverage —— 26 fire fighters and peace officers. 27 1. For the purposes of this section: 28 a. “Eligible peace officer or fire fighter” means a peace 29 officer as defined in section 801.4, or a fire fighter, who is 30 receiving an accidental disability benefit as a result of a 31 work-related physical disability or injury. 32 b. “Employer” means a governing body, a county board of 33 supervisors, or a city council. 34 2. If an employer has procured accident or health care 35 -2- LSB 6966YC (3) 91 nls/ko 2/ 4 H.F. _____ coverage for its active employees pursuant to a collective 1 bargaining agreement or employer policy, the employer must 2 provide, at the employer’s expense, such coverage for an 3 eligible peace officer or fire fighter for twenty-four 4 consecutive months beginning on the date of the eligible peace 5 officer’s or fire fighter’s work-related physical disability 6 or injury. 7 EXPLANATION 8 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 9 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 10 This bill relates to health insurance coverage for surviving 11 spouses and children of deceased fire fighters and peace 12 officers; and health insurance coverage for disabled or injured 13 fire fighters and peace officers. 14 Under current law, if a governing body, a county board of 15 supervisors, or a city council has procured accident or health 16 care coverage (coverage) for its employees, such coverage shall 17 permit continuation of existing coverage or reenrollment in 18 previously existing coverage for the surviving spouse and each 19 surviving child (surviving family) of an eligible peace officer 20 or fire fighter. 21 The bill eliminates the provision under current law that 22 an employer providing accident or health care coverage is not 23 required to pay for the cost of the coverage, but may pay the 24 full cost or a portion of the cost of the coverage. The bill 25 eliminates the provision under current law that if the full 26 cost of the coverage is not paid, a surviving family eligible 27 for coverage may elect to continue accident or health care 28 coverage by paying that portion of the cost of the coverage not 29 paid by the employer. 30 Under the bill, if an employer has procured accident or 31 health care coverage for its employees, such coverage shall 32 require continuation of existing coverage or reenrollment in 33 previously existing coverage for 24 months, beginning on the 34 date of the death, for the surviving family of an eligible 35 -3- LSB 6966YC (3) 91 nls/ko 3/ 4 H.F. _____ peace officer or fire fighter, and the employer shall pay the 1 full premium. The bill defines “employer” as a governing body, 2 a county board of supervisors, or a city council. 3 Under the bill, if an employer has procured accident or 4 health care coverage for its active employees pursuant to 5 a collective bargaining agreement or employer policy, the 6 employer must provide, at the employer’s expense, such coverage 7 for a peace officer or a fire fighter who is receiving an 8 accidental disability benefit as a result of a work-related 9 physical disability or injury for 24 months beginning on the 10 date of the disability or injury. 11 -4- LSB 6966YC (3) 91 nls/ko 4/ 4
